info.title: Library Management & Intelligent Book Recommendation System API
info.description: RESTful API documentation for the 12-Factor Library Management and Recommendation System. Provides complete specifications for user authentication (JWT & OTP), role-based access control (Student, Librarian, Admin), book catalog search with TF-IDF recommendations, circulation lifecycle, in-app messaging, and analytics dashboards.

servers.description: Docker Compose Nginx Gateway (Frontend + API Proxy)

post.description: Sends a secure 6-digit OTP code to the specified email via Brevo transactional email (or terminal console in dev mode). Rate-limited to max 3 attempts per 10 minutes.

400.description: Validation error or rate limit exceeded

post.description: Validates the 6-digit code. On success, issues a single-use verification token valid for 30 minutes for registration or password reset.

post.description: Registers a new student account. Requires a verified OTP session token. Account starts in 'pending' status until approved by the department librarian.
